summary: Netanyahu explicitly rejected the Gaza 15-point peace plan, vowing no IDF withdrawal until Hamas is fully disarmed. Iran retains leverage over the Strait of Hormuz and threatens regional energy facilities, while Trump reportedly considers ending the Iran war without a nuclear deal if the strait reopens. Hezbollah condemned an Israeli map annexing south Lebanon and accused Lebanese authorities of concessions.
key_points: Netanyahu rejects Gaza peace plan, demands full Hamas disarmament including all heavy, medium, light weapons, and rules out Palestinian state. (Source: @VahidOnline/77790)
Iran holds Strait of Hormuz leverage and can threaten neighbors' energy facilities; Trump may end war without nuclear deal if Iran reopens strait. (Source: @SharghDaily/177114, @Faytuks_Network/6183)
Hezbollah denounces Israeli Foreign Ministry map incorporating occupied south Lebanon, urges Lebanese government to file UN Security Council complaint. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/383628)
Turkish FM Hakan Fidan announces defense pact with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan akin to NATO Article 5, with Egypt possibly joining. (Source: @asafroz/52357)
Yemeni armed forces (Ansarallah) launch missile wave at Al-Mukha International Port; smoke plume observed at geolocation 13.31092, 43.23097. (Source: @shin_persian/8913, @SharghDaily/177116)

Israeli forces conduct operations in Lebanon, eliminating terrorists at Ali Taher ridge; artillery shelling hits Wadi Salouqi and area between Bani Hayan and Talousa. (Source: @almogboker78/17929, @rasedal3ado138e/383613)
Pentagon orders US defense industry to accelerate weapons production within 21 days due to "extreme shortage" from Iran war. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94106)
Rosatom returns specialists to Iran's Bushehr nuclear plant; 25 currently on site, planning 100 by autumn. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6185)

points: Iranian former US State Department official states Iran retains leverage over Strait of Hormuz and can threaten neighboring energy facilities, while knowing Trump is eager to end the war. (Source: @SharghDaily/177114)
Trump privately told senior aides he may end the Iran war without a nuclear deal if Tehran fully reopens the Strait of Hormuz, according to US officials. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6183)

Russian state nuclear company Rosatom has returned specialists to Iran's Bushehr nuclear power plant; five recently arrived, bringing total to 25, with plans to increase to 100 by autumn. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6185)
Iranian official Mohammad Javad Larijani calls for taking revenge by force, indicating hardline stance. (Source: @kianmeli1/90760)

Wall Street Journal reports Trump is laying groundwork to declare victory in war with Iran if Iran reopens Strait of Hormuz, and has floated ending war without nuclear deal. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/79011)

Netanyahu explicitly rejects the 15-point Gaza peace plan from the Board of Peace, stating IDF will not withdraw until Hamas is genuinely disarmed of all heavy, medium, and light weapons. (Source: @VahidOnline/77790)

Netanyahu asserts Israel is conducting powerful operations in Lebanon, eliminating terrorists including at Ali Taher ridge, and emphasizes working with IDF to eliminate threats with determination and wisdom. (Source: @almogboker78/17929)

Israeli Foreign Ministry warns Israelis in Greece of protests at dozens of locations, urging avoidance of gatherings, hiding Israeli/Jewish symbols, and not posting real-time locations. (Source: @pkpoi/143560)
Pentagon has directed US defense industries to accelerate weapons production within 21 days due to "extreme shortage" of ammunition caused by the war with Iran. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94106)

Netanyahu states Israel is in talks with Americans; some ideas acceptable, some not, but Israel's security is non-negotiable and no Palestinian state will be established while he is PM. (Source: @VahidOnline/77790)
Hamas urges mediators and the US to pressure Netanyahu to abide by the peace roadmap created by the Board of Peace. (Source: @presstv/202136)
Netanyahu rejects the 15-point Gaza plan, insisting on full Hamas disarmament and ruling out any Palestinian state in Gaza or West Bank. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6182)
Hezbollah media highlights "shooting in the heads" hero of sacred crossing, commander of Caliphs Battalion in Jabalia camp Abu Suhaib Al-Bayari. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/383627)
Israeli operations continue in Gaza with no withdrawal until Hamas disarmed; Netanyahu emphasizes real disarmament not fictional. (Source: @amitsegal/63739)

Hezbollah condemns Israeli Foreign Ministry map incorporating occupied south Lebanon into Israel, calling it proof of Israeli ambitions, and demands Lebanese government file urgent UN Security Council complaint. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/383628)
Artillery shelling on south Lebanon: six shells hit Wadi Salouqi, two shells hit area between Bani Hayan and Talousa. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/383613)
Israeli forces carried out an explosion in the town of Sarbin, south Lebanon. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/383610)
UNIFIL scheduled controlled detonation of unexploded ordnance in Sarbin at 1:10 PM, advising residents not to panic. (Source: @redlinkleb/35485)
Lebanese army helicopters deployed to West Bekaa to assist in extinguishing large fires in Jroud and mountains of Mashghara and Midoun. (Source: @redlinkleb/35486)

Syrian Foreign Ministry announces Damascus and Moscow reached a memorandum of understanding regulating future of Russian bases in Tartus and Hmeimim, to reorganize Russian presence along Syrian coast after 18 months of negotiations. (Source: @asafroz/52362)

Iraqi MP Ghaleb Mohammed reveals ongoing smuggling of oil derivatives from Lanaz refinery in Erbil to Turkey via Turkish trucks, despite quantities designated for Kurdistan citizens. (Source: @naya_foriraq/87388)
Intense USAF jet activity reported over Maysan and Baghdad, Iraq. (Source: @shin_persian/8911)

Iraqi MP Ahmed Shahid submitted formal request to Media and Communications Commission to stop Al-Khenjar Al-Udr and Al-Falluja sectarian channels for calling Hashd martyrs "dead" and Saudi mercenaries in Yemen "martyrs". (Source: @naya_foriraq/87380)
Hezbollah media references commander of Caliphs Battalion in Jabalia camp, indicating cross-border militant coordination. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/383627)
Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan describes defense pact with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan as akin to NATO Article 5, with Egypt potentially joining. (Source: @asafroz/52357)

Analysis suggests potential "Mecca Pact" between Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan could signal new regional security order amid shared concerns over instability from Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, and Iran-Israel confrontation. (Source: @SharghDaily/177117)

Saudi Arabia seeks to reduce security vulnerability and consolidate position; Turkey monitors Syria, Eastern Mediterranean tensions; Pakistan faces eastern border challenges and rivalry with India. (Source: @SharghDaily/177117)
Regional wars have shattered traditional red lines, prompting Gulf states to reassess defense strategies and traditional alliances. (Source: @SharghDaily/177117)
